hypothesis: Modifying policy scoring heuristics to explicitly value holding an Ace or K♠ in hand (applying a retention bonus) increases match win rate against aggressive opponents compared to immediate reactive counter firing.
independentVariable: Policy counter retention bonus: 0 (default one-ply) vs +300 vs +600 hand-retention bonus
stratification: target value (minor bounce vs lethal threat)
counterfactualUsage: counterfactual.mjs evaluation at each counter decision point
falsificationCriterion: If retaining counters yields a lower win rate across 100 paired matches, the hypothesis that AI undervalues counter retention is falsified.
